recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Rune Vale: Relic Oath` as a mobile portrait browser game using a single self-contained HTML surface plus stable Three.js support. Preserve the implemented mechanics: camera-relative joystick movement, action buttons for summon/enter/exit, attack and tool switch, camera rotate, zoom slider, AABB obstacle collisions, health damage/failure, pressure escalation/decay, and chaser spawning. Reinterpret the source as a Zelda-like mythic overworld adventure: the player is a green-and-gold rune knight, the world is mossy forest temple ruins, static blockers are sealed dungeon stones, the ride is a summonable rune stag, hostile NPCs are cursed sentries, chasers are guardian riders, health is hearts, pressure is curse stars, and tools are blade/bow. Use procedural browser-native art: moss textures, rune blocks, shrine pillars, floating motes, glowing sky relics, fantasy HUD panels, and touch-friendly controls. Do not add new win/inventory/puzzle rules; express item-gated and dungeon fantasy through visuals, copy, and role mapping while preserving mechanic truth.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: 3D mobile-first free-roam action sandbox with simple combat, vehicle/mount interaction, chaser pressure, obstacle collision, and health failure.
- objective: move through an open field, use attack/tool controls, summon or enter a ride, survive escalating pursuers, and avoid health reaching zero.
- input model: touch joystick for camera-relative movement, action buttons for interact/summon/enter/exit, attack, tool switch, camera rotate, plus a zoom slider and start/restart buttons.
- core loop: start game, roam, collide with blockers, attack nearby entities or shoot a ranged line, summon/enter vehicle, pressure meter escalates on defeating enemies, chasers spawn, health can be depleted, restart after failure.
- fail/friction state: collisions block movement; moving chasers/rides can damage the player; zero health stops the loop and reveals the failure/restart screen.

## Protected Mechanics
- Camera-relative joystick movement and pointer lifecycle.
- Attack cadence and range semantics: short melee hit and ranged line tool.
- Action button semantics: summon if no ride is close, enter close ride, exit when riding.
- Ride acceleration/steering, camera follow, and player hiding while mounted.
- Static AABB obstacle collision behavior.
- Pressure escalation/decay, chaser spawning, health damage, failure, and restart.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
- Title, copy, HUD vocabulary, icons, palette, typography, control chrome, audio mapping, generated textures, mesh colors, entity silhouettes, background props, feedback overlays, and failure wording.

## Remix Trajectory
The rebuilt game reinterprets the source as `Rune Vale: Relic Oath`, a mythic Zelda-like adventure through forest ruins and dungeon stones. It preserves the free-roam combat/ride/chase loop while making the world read as heroic overworld exploration, rune-steed traversal, blade/bow stances, curse pressure, guardian pursuit, and oath failure.
